artworks.title: Theseus and Antiope (pedimental group from the Temple of Apollo Daphnephoros, Eretria)
artworks.description: Archaic marble from Eretria: Theseus carries off the Amazon Antiope — the abduction that sparks Athens' Amazon war and, in many tellings, makes her the mother of Hippolytus. Now in the Archaeological Museum of Eretria.

artworks.title: Theseus and Antiope (metope of the Athenian Treasury at Delphi)
artworks.description: Delphi, Athenian Treasury: Theseus and the Amazon Antiope locked in the struggle of her abduction. The metope is a flagship Archaic image of the Amazon consort, distinct from the Theban Antiope of Zeus.

artworks.title: The Abduction of Antiope by Theseus
artworks.description: A fifth-century relief (National Archaeological Museum, Athens) of Theseus seizing the Amazon Antiope — the war-bride whose capture opens the Amazonomachy in Athenian myth.

popCulture.title: Antiope (Amazon)
popCulture.description: Theseus' Amazon consort endures as the mother of Hippolytus in many tellings — the war-bride whose abduction sparked Athens' Amazon war.
